item.title: Identifying and Treating Osteoarthritis with Wearables
item.description: via UNC School of Medicine Researchers at UNC-Chapel Hill and NC State University are developing a wearable system to detect and treat harmful walking patterns linked to the early signs of knee osteoarthritis and mobility problems. Instead of needing specialized equipment or a specialist’s appointment, people can wear a small portable device during everyday walking. […]
